policy: A gate may become true only from repository-verifiable evidence. Green CI is necessary but not sufficient. Missing evidence must remain false; no name-only geography equivalence, missing-to-zero conversion, person-level publication, or unsupported derived indicator is permitted.

priority_current_payloads_authoritativel.reason: Priority current/differently dated sources are not all publication-ready authoritative payloads.

immutable_raw_or_api_provenance_complete.reason: Evidence exists for selected sources, but the required source-by-source coverage is incomplete.

rights_and_attribution_complete.reason: Resource-specific review exists for selected evidence; full publication scope is not yet cleared.

observed_schema_and_semantics_validated.reason: NHD systematic-zero capacity fields and other source semantics remain unresolved.

record_level_temporal_interpretation_val.reason: NHD metadata dates and Monthly granularity do not establish facility-record reference periods.

geographic_linkage_evidence_backed.reason: NHD State_ID/District_ID values remain uninterpreted; Census/current geography equivalence is not inferred from names.

privacy_safe_curated_current_tables.reason: Current publication-ready curated facility/service tables have not passed all privacy and evidence gates.

derived_indicators_supported.reason: Unsupported current indicators remain prohibited pending semantic, temporal, denominator and geography validation.

research_ready_downloads_reports_current.reason: Only validated evidence may be exposed; current-layer release artifacts are not yet publication-ready.

streamlit_synchronized_with_validated_ou.reason: Historical validated evidence is exposed, but final current-layer synchronization cannot be satisfied before upstream gates.

exact_final_main_green_ci.reason: The final completion head does not yet exist. CI success on an intermediate head cannot satisfy the final completion gate.

completion_rule: module_complete and publication_allowed may become true only when every required gate above is satisfied and green CI is verified on the exact final main head.
